notice: Synthetic educational fixture. Not live telemetry.

workflow.title: KEV applicability & remediation review
workflow.summary: Preserve the selected CVE, validate hypothetical asset applicability and prepare a remediation ticket after approval. No patch or external ticket is created.

nodes.title: CISA intelligence
nodes.description: Load the selected record with provenance.
nodes.detail: CISA KEV records known exploitation. It does not report which of your systems are affected or compromised.

nodes.title: Evidence enrichment
nodes.description: Preserve source context and enrichment limits.
nodes.detail: Optional NVD and FIRST requests are explicit lookups. This graph attaches the selected evidence and never invents a CVSS score or ATT&CK technique.

nodes.title: Normalize record
nodes.description: Keep severity, likelihood and confidence separate.
nodes.detail: A missing score remains unknown. Catalog addition date is not the date exploitation first occurred.

nodes.title: Asset correlation
nodes.description: Compare against a hypothetical lab inventory.
nodes.detail: The affected-asset toggle is a teaching assumption. Confirm version, exposure and vendor applicability before real remediation.

nodes.title: Analyst review
nodes.description: Review required actions and supporting evidence.
nodes.detail: Read the vendor advisory and confirm affected versions. Generic KEV membership does not justify a specific exploit signature.

nodes.title: Protective decision
nodes.description: Choose a review path based on applicability.
nodes.detail: No affected lab asset means no proposed response. Preserve the record for future monitoring.

nodes.title: Change approval
nodes.detail: Approval here is only for a dry run. Real remediation needs authorization, a maintenance plan and rollback.

nodes.title: Remediation proposal
nodes.description: Prepare a remediation ticket without execution.
nodes.detail: Use the CISA required action as source context; verify vendor instructions and organizational constraints.

nodes.title: Verify & record
nodes.description: Record the proposed action and verification criteria.
nodes.detail: Verify deployed version and coverage after authorized remediation. No asset scan or patch installation occurs here.
